My Summer Car or My Winter Car · the lau: Under the version number, top left: pick your game, My Summer Car or My Winter Car. The launcher restarts on the chosen game. Everyone must be on the same game to play together.
My Summer Car joins MWCoop: pick MSC under the version number, top left of the launcher.

Under the version number, top left of the launcher: the game you play, My Summer Car (MSC) or My Winter Car (MWC). The launcher restarts on the chosen game: its folder, its saves and its Steam friends. Everyone must be on the same game to play together; when joining a host on the other game, the launcher offers to switch.
My Summer Car: nearly everything of My Winter Car is shared (players, cars, mechanics, money, jobs, radio, world). The details, and what exists only in My Winter Car: \"What works on My Summer Car\".

Players and their moves, their outfits and faces, voice, chat, markers, the cars (SATSUMA, GIFU, KEKMET, HAYOSIKO, FERNDALE, RUSCKO, JONNEZ, FLATBED, the boat, the VAZ-2108 and the add-ons), the host's time and weather, traffic and NPCs, jobs, money, shops, mechanics, radio, drag races and the rally… The details: \"What works on My Summer Car\".

Most MSCLoader mods work in co-op as long as they only do things for you. On My Summer Car, MWCoop doesn't sync any mod: the objects or vehicles a mod adds are only seen by the players who have it. Here are also the mods to avoid.
My Summer Car is played in MWCoop with the same launcher, the same lobby and the same F10 menu. To play together, everyone must be on MSC (top left of the launcher).
Since msc-1.15.1: drag race results with the other players' times, rally trophies for everyone, and a podium that waits for the other human drivers.
Something wrong? Report a bug (the bug icon at the top right): the form and the logs zip.
